params.token_: ERC-20 token for all orders (e.g. Arc Testnet USDC).

params.deadline: Unix timestamp after which funding is closed.
params.merchant: Address that will receive the full payment on settle.                      Must not be zero or this contract (self-transfer would                      mark the order settled while funds stay in escrow).
params.orderId: Unique identifier chosen by the organizer.
params.ref: Arbitrary order reference string (SKU, invoice, etc.).
params.shares: Corresponding agreed share per contributor (sums == target).
params.target: Total amount in token's native units (6 decimals for USDC).

fund(bytes32,uint256).details: Caller must have approved this contract for at least `amount`.         Rejects fee-on-transfer tokens: requires exact balance receipt.

getOrder(bytes32).details: token() is read from the immutable state variable, not per-order.

MAX_CONTRIBUTORS().notice: Maximum number of contributors per order.

fund(bytes32,uint256).notice: Contribute towards your share of an order.

getContribution(bytes32,address).notice: Returns a contributor's share and current contribution for an order.

getContributors(bytes32).notice: Returns the contributor list for an order.

getOrder(bytes32).notice: Returns the immutable and mutable top-level fields of an order.

refund(bytes32).notice: Reclaim your contribution after deadline on an incomplete order.         Pull-based: caller must be the contributor; only their own funds.         Not available if the order was fully funded (settled or settleable).

settle(bytes32).notice: Settle a fully-funded order: transfer the full amount to merchant.         Permissionless — anyone may call once totalFunded == target.         Callable both before and after deadline if fully funded.

token().notice: The single ERC-20 token accepted by all orders on this deployment. Fixed at construction; cannot be changed.

totalEscrowLiability().notice: Total token liability this contract owes (sum of all unfinalised contributions). Tracked separately so accidental token transfers cannot inflate entitlements.

documentation.text:
The single ERC-20 token accepted by all orders on this deployment.
 Fixed at construction; cannot be changed.
Maximum number of contributors per order.
All orders, keyed by a bytes32 orderId chosen by the organizer at create.
Ordered list of contributors per order (for existence checks).

Total token liability this contract owes (sum of all unfinalised contributions).
 Tracked separately so accidental token transfers cannot inflate entitlements.
@param token_ ERC-20 token for all orders (e.g. Arc Testnet USDC).

@notice Returns the immutable and mutable top-level fields of an order.
 @dev    token() is read from the immutable state variable, not per-order.
@notice Returns the contributor list for an order.
@notice Returns a contributor's share and current contribution for an order.
